findings.summary: All previous E0-E7 evidence is toy/exploratory and below protocol floors.
E1/E2 campaign variants use mismatched seeds but were analyzed as paired.
Overshoot is request under-reservation rather than tenant budget-window overshoot.
No model-specific hidden outcome matrix, quality metric, leakage-safe feedback or oracle exists.
Workspace storage cannot safely hold JSON-scale final events; compressed columnar evidence and Linux scratch are required.

recommended_pilot.E1: 5 development seeds x 20000 shared requests over 12 corner/center cells
recommended_pilot.E2: 5 development seeds x 20000 events over 8 scenarios
recommended_pilot.E3: 5 development seeds x 5000 events over nominal plus 13 drift conditions
recommended_pilot.E5: 2-minute development measurements at 10/1000/10000 objects and one/multiple replicas
recommended_pilot.E6: 30 successes per model in one pilot window
